help:
Reverse-engineer files with REA (rea-agents 6.8.0) in tm8's RE Lab on tm8-server.

REA covers native binaries, APKs, firmware, pcaps, wasm, SQLite and more, and every finding is an Evidence record (ev_...): the provider, the subject's sha256, and the result with its limitations. Each call runs in a fresh gVisor container with no network. Only the case is mounted: targets/ read-only, out/ and work/ writable. Inside the sandbox, a case's files are at /case/targets/<name>.

1. Put a file into a case: --command intake --case <name> --source <file> (or --url <https-url>).
2. See what you may call: --command tools; add --tool <name> for that tool's input schema.
3. Call a tool: --command call --case <name> --tool <tool> --arguments '<json>'.

Runs on the same case, role and profile share one warm REA. The first call pays for the analysis (a cold Ghidra call takes ~40 s); later runs reuse the opened binary until --command stop or 15 idle minutes end it. A tool run carries no teammate id, so members.json does not apply: the role is --role, or all. A teammate calling rea-sandbox from their own session gets the role members.json gives them. The static profile (the default) never runs the target. --profile exec runs it, without licensed or heavy engines.

Example, run in this order on 2026-10-31:
  tm8 tool run rea --command intake --case demo --source ./hello
  tm8 tool run rea --case demo --tool open_binary --arguments '{"path":"/case/targets/hello"}'
  tm8 tool run rea --case demo --tool procedure_pseudo_code --arguments '{"procedure":"main"}'
The last call returns Ghidra Evidence (evidence_id ev_..., the binary's sha256, the decompiled main).

Exit status: 0 ok; 1 REA answered with an error; 2 bad input, REA unavailable or not installed; 3 the tool is outside your role or profile (the message names who to route it to); 64 a missing --tool, --source or --url. See tools/rea/README.md.

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: call: one REA tool call. tools: the tools your role may call (with --tool, that tool's schema). intake: copy --source or --url into the case. doctor, engines, scope, ps: lab health and your scope. stop: end this case's warm REA.

inputs.name: tool
inputs.description: The REA tool, e.g. inspect_artifact, open_binary, procedure_pseudo_code. --command tools lists them.

inputs.name: arguments
inputs.description: The tool's arguments as a JSON object. Paths are inside the sandbox: /case/targets/<name>.

inputs.name: case
inputs.description: The case folder under /home/tm8/rea-lab/cases: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Use a task id to file the work under that task. Default: adhoc.

inputs.name: role
inputs.description: Which tool families and engines to use (default all). Narrow it to see what a teammate with that role sees.

inputs.name: profile
inputs.description: static never runs the target and may use the owner's licensed engines. exec may run it, without licensed or heavy engines.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: --command intake: a file or folder to copy into the case's targets/ (read-only there, sha256 logged in work/intake.jsonl).

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: --command intake: an https URL to download into the case's targets/ (at most 4 GiB).
